name: mot-evidence-commercial
description: Commercial iOS and Android build of MOT Photo Evidence

scripts.native:init: npm run build && npx cap add ios && npx cap add android && npm run native:configure && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync && npm run native:configure
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
